name: Nvidia Shield
pros: Wi-Fi support (Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n, dual-band) for data-free browsing and connectivity
5 MP camera capable of capturing good photos for its release era
Nvidia Tegra K1 chipset provides balanced everyday performance
Li-Ion 5400 mAh battery offers solid operating endurance for daily use
cons: No official IP rating for dust or water resistance
Standard charging speeds without ultra-fast charging support

reviews.title: Solid performance for its 2014 launch era
reviews.body: Picking this up around its release period, the Android 4.4.2, up to 7.0 experience felt snappy and responsive for the price tier. The 5 MP camera delivered reliable shots in outdoor lighting.

reviews.title: Reliable battery and daily usability
reviews.body: The Li-Ion 5400 mAh power cell paired with Nvidia's software tuning easily lasted through a full work day with mixed web browsing, calls, and media playback.

reviews.title: Refined hardware styling and build
reviews.body: The physical chassis of the Nvidia Shield feels well-balanced in hand. Its 221 x 126 x 9.2 mm (8.70 x 4.96 x 0.36 in) make it easy to hold during long daily sessions.

reviews.title: Great value for the hardware specifications
reviews.body: For the price point, getting Nvidia Tegra K1 performance alongside 16GB storage, microSDXC made the Nvidia Shield an easy recommendation among rivals in 2014.

reviews.title: Smooth day-to-day software responsiveness
reviews.body: Operating on Android 4.4.2, up to 7.0, the user interface is intuitive with smooth system transitions. Core apps and browsing run without noticeable stutter.

reviews.title: Dependable display and audio clarity
reviews.body: The screen (Li-Ion 5400 mAh, non-removable (19.75 Wh), 8.0", 1920x1200 pixels) produces vibrant colors for video streaming, and call clarity through the earpiece is crystal clear.

reviews.title: A well-rounded package from Nvidia
reviews.body: Overall, the Nvidia Shield proved to be a durable and well-engineered mobile device representing Nvidia's design philosophy nicely.
